name: Image to Base64
summary: Convert an image to a Base64 data URL, raw string, CSS background, or HTML img tag — in your browser.
description: Drop a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, or SVG and get Base64 output as a data URL, raw Base64, CSS background-image, or an HTML img snippet. Encoding runs entirely locally so files never leave your device.

faqs.question: Is my image uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Data URL vs raw Base64?
faqs.answer: A data URL includes the MIME prefix (data:image/…;base64,) and can be pasted into HTML or CSS. Raw Base64 is only the encoded bytes.

faqs.question: How large can the image be?
faqs.answer: Limited by your browser memory. Very large images produce long Base64 strings that may be awkward to paste into markup.
